paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter with a multiple-cell haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted by me from the paper's quoted limit g_agamma >~ 11.1 x g_KSVZ, using g_KSVZ = (alpha*0.97/pi)/f_a with m_a = 5.7 ueV x (1e12 GeV / f_a))
notes: First results from CAPP-9T multiple-cell (double-cell) cavity haloscope. Excludes axions with g_agamma >~ 11.1 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL over 13.0-13.9 ueV (3.14-3.36 GHz), assuming rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Detailed exclusion curve is only in Fig. 5; I emitted the endpoints of the flat 11.1x-KSVZ limit converted to absolute GeV^-1 values (KSVZ g scales linearly with mass).
